        })

    # Concatenate all source DataFrames vertically (union)

    # Optional: Validate final schema and types
    combined_df = combined_df.astype({
        'admit': 'int64',
        'gre': 'int64',
        'gpa': 'float64',
        'prestige': 'int64'
    })

    # Write the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_93/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    combined_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

    main()
